scenes.headline: That Relaunch button matters
scenes.body: Your browser isn't patched until you click it.
scenes.say: Chrome users: that Relaunch button is not optional. Here's why.

scenes.headline: exploited zero-days fixed
scenes.body: At least seven, attacked before a fix existed
scenes.say: This year Google has fixed at least seven Chrome zero-days that attackers were already exploiting.

scenes.headline: One booby-trapped web page
scenes.body: CVE-2026-87491 in Chrome's V8 engine could run attacker code inside Chrome's sandbox.
scenes.say: The latest, in Chrome's V8 engine, could let an attacker run code inside Chrome's sandbox, just by getting you to load a booby-trapped web page.

scenes.headline: Reported, exploited, listed

items.text: Researcher reports the bug to Google

scenes.say: A researcher reported it on August sixth. On September ninth, the US agency CISA listed it as exploited, and gave federal agencies until September twelfth to patch.

scenes.headline: Downloaded isn't installed.
scenes.body: Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi share this engine. Update them too.
scenes.say: Analyst note: Chrome downloads fixes quietly, but they only take effect after a relaunch. And Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi share this engine, so update those too.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
items: Menu, then Help, then About Google Chrome
scenes.say: Tonight: open the menu, then Help, then About Google Chrome. Let it update and click Relaunch. Then do the same in your other browsers.

scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
